clue.text: Lost one's temper with a guard

definitions.meaning: to rail at someone is to rant angrily at them
fitted with a rail, such as a protective barrier along a walkway

explanation.surface: Someone flies off the handle at a security guard.
explanation.definitionFit: Railing is ranting in anger, and a railed path is one fenced by a protective barrier.

clue.text: Refuse to make a scathing comment

definitions.meaning: to criticise harshly, dismiss as worthless

explanation.surface: Someone declines to say anything cutting.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubbish is household waste, and to rubbish something is to disparage it.

clue.text: In the meantime I am off to Bury

indicators.note: off means removed, so these letters go from the word for meantime

parts.note: interim means in the meantime
I am contracts to IM

explanation.surface: Someone explains that for now they are heading to the town of Bury.
explanation.walkthrough: Bury, capitalised to look like the Lancashire town, is the verb to bury.
explanation.definitionFit: To inter is to place a body in a grave, which is to bury it.

clue.text: See it as an anagram — nothing could be simpler

indicators.note: the clue openly tells you to treat these words as letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A setter tells you to spot an obvious anagram, saying it couldn't be easier.
explanation.definitionFit: Easiest is the superlative of easy, the least difficult possible, so nothing is simpler.

clue.text: Physical training instructor

definitions.meaning: ... work is done with the hands and body
a handbook that teaches you how to do or operate something

explanation.surface: A gym's PT coach is described.
explanation.definitionFit: Manual labour is bodily work, and a manual is a handbook of instructions for learning a task.

clue.text: Jack training for the fifteen? That's sudden!

parts.note: a jack tar is a sailor, AB being an able-bodied seaman
Rugby Union is played fifteen a side, abbreviated RU
PT is physical training

explanation.surface: A player's fitness work for the rugby team comes to an unexpected end.
explanation.definitionFit: Abrupt means sudden and unexpected.

clue.text: Subject to job stress

parts.note: to be under something is to be subject to it
one's line is one's line of work, a job

explanation.surface: Someone suffers from work pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stress' reads as anxiety, but it is the verb to emphasise.
explanation.definitionFit: To underline is to emphasise or stress something.

clue.text: Motorist waiting for a chance to pass

definitions.text: Motorist waiting for a chance to pass

parts.words: Motorist waiting for a chance to pass
parts.note: not a driver stuck behind a lorry, but one hoping to pass the driving test

explanation.surface: A driver waits to overtake.
explanation.definitionFit: A learner driver has not yet passed the driving test.

clue.text: Killing time

parts.note: read not as idling away hours but as the period when hunting game is allowed

explanation.surface: Someone idles away the hours.
explanation.definitionFit: The hunting season is the period of the year when shooting animals is permitted.

clue.text: Come very close to a qualification

parts.note: a but is a reservation or proviso, as in 'no ifs or buts'

explanation.surface: A student nearly earns a diploma.
explanation.definitionFit: To abut is to border on or touch, lying right up against something.

clue.text: Quits the board with a fair agreement

parts.note: to be square is to be even or quits, owing nothing
deal is pine or fir timber, sawn into boards

explanation.surface: Someone resigns from the company board after a fair settlement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quits' looks like a verb about resigning, but it is the adjective 'even'.
explanation.definitionFit: A square deal is an idiom for an honest, equitable bargain.

clue.text: Drill using bit right inside

indicators.note: the letter for right is placed within the word for bit

parts.note: a piece is a bit or portion

explanation.surface: A workman drills a hole with a bit set correctly inside the tool.
explanation.definitionFit: To pierce is to bore through, just as a drill makes a hole.

clue.text: Contracting to record Wagnerian opera

parts.note: to tape is to record on tape
Wagner's Ring cycle, Der Ring des Nibelungen

explanation.surface: A firm is hired to make a recording of a Wagner opera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contracting' suggests signing a deal, but it means narrowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Tapering is getting narrower toward one end, a way of contracting or shrinking.

clue.text: It gives an edge to the news broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast as scattered widely, so these letters are spread and rearranged

explanation.surface: Something adds a sharp edge to the news bulletin on air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' looks like radio or TV, but it signals a rearrangement of TO THE NEWS.
explanation.definitionFit: A whetstone is a sharpening stone used to put an edge on blades.

clue.text: Put off rate increase

parts.note: tempo is speed or rate
a rise is an increase

explanation.surface: A pay rise is postponed.
explanation.definitionFit: To temporise is to delay or stall to gain time, putting off a decision.

clue.text: False witness who turns to abuse

indicators.note: the word for abuse turns round, read backwards

parts.note: to rail is to abuse verbally

explanation.surface: A perjurer in the witness box resorts to insults.
explanation.definitionFit: A false witness tells untruths, which is what a person who lies does.

clue.text: It may be well-worn and well-used

definitions.text: It may be well-worn and well-used

parts.words: It may be well-worn and well-used
parts.note: one sense is a light dancing shoe often worn, the other a device used at a well to draw water

explanation.surface: Something old and much used, like a favourite tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A pump is both a light shoe that is worn and the handle device used to raise water at a well.

clue.text: Apply no make-up when in full array

indicators.note: make-up as composition, so these letters are made up into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone goes without cosmetics even when dressed in all their finery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make-up' reads as cosmetics, but signals a rearrangement of APPLY NO.
explanation.definitionFit: A panoply is a complete and impressive collection or display.

clue.text: Property conveyance?

parts.note: an estate is landed property
a car is a vehicle, a means of conveyance

explanation.surface: A lawyer handles the conveyancing of a property.
explanation.walkthrough: 'conveyance' suggests the legal transfer of property, but here it is a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate car is a vehicle with an extended rear load space, a conveyance named after estates.

clue.text: The attendant's not responsible for it

definitions.text: The attendant's not responsible for it

parts.words: The attendant's not responsible for it
parts.note: not a steward shirking duty, but someone attending, present, who cannot be the cause of not being there

explanation.surface: A steward denies responsibility for something.
explanation.definitionFit: Absence is not being present, which no one who attends can be blamed for.

clue.text: Food I am given in a time of abstinence

indicators.note: the contraction is given a place in the middle of the period

parts.note: Lent is the Christian period of fasting before Easter
I am contracts to IM

explanation.surface: Someone is fed during a fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Aliment is a formal word for nourishment or food.

clue.text: Straighten things out and become more friendly

definitions.meaning: to make something straight that was bent
to relax and become less formal

explanation.surface: Someone settles a quarrel and warms up.
explanation.definitionFit: To unbend is to straighten something, and also to relax one's stiff manner.

clue.text: One can't sleep through it

parts.note: read not as a noise you would wake to, but as the condition of being unable to sleep

explanation.surface: Something too loud to sleep through.
explanation.definitionFit: Insomnia is the condition of chronic sleeplessness.

clue.text: Points to one of several children as being bright

definitions.note: noun phrase: a thing that is bright, a glittering spangle

parts.note: S and E are two compass points, south and east
a quin is one of five children born at one birth

explanation.surface: A parent singles out one of a brood as clever.
explanation.definitionFit: A sequin is a small shiny disc sewn on clothes, an object that gleams brightly.

clue.text: Flinch, though still game

definitions.meaning: to cower or recoil in fear
a small game bird related to the partridge

explanation.surface: Someone recoils, though still willing to have a go.
explanation.walkthrough: 'game' reads as willing, but it is a bird shot for sport.
explanation.definitionFit: To quail is to shrink in fear, and the quail is a small bird hunted as game.

clue.text: Topsy-turvy promotion team relegated

parts.note: a team going up a league is promoted
a side is a team
a relegated team goes down

explanation.surface: A football team promoted one season and relegated the next has a chaotic time.
explanation.definitionFit: Topsy-turvy means in a state of inversion or confusion, with things the wrong way round.

clue.text: Give aid to a Yankee

parts.note: a Yankee is a type of accumulator bet on four selections, a British bookmaking term

explanation.surface: Someone helps an American.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yankee' looks like an American, but a Yankee is a bet placed with a British bookmaker.
explanation.definitionFit: To abet is to assist or support someone, often in wrongdoing.

clue.text: Capitulates and provides youth leader with new slide

indicators.note: the first letter of the word it picks from

parts.note: the first letter of the word youth

indicators.note: new signals the letters of slide being made fresh in another order

explanation.surface: Someone gives in and lets a youth club leader have a new playground slide.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and provides' is a second definition: to yield is also to produce or supply.
explanation.definitionFit: Yields means surrenders or gives way, the same as capitulates.

clue.text: Motel right to provide wine

indicators.note: the letters are worked up to provide something new, a loose anagram signal

explanation.surface: A roadside motel offers its guests wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Merlot is a red grape variety and the wine made from it.
